title: Pork Udon Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Japanese-style stir-fry made with pork and udon noodles. Serve hot with a side of steamed vegetables.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced pork and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the snow peas to the skillet and cook until tender, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the udon noodles to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Return the cooked pork to the skillet and stir in 2 tablespoons of soy sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the pork is coated in the sauce.
